title: ageratina pelotropha
intro: Ageratina pelotropha, commonly known as Mexican mint, is a plant species within the Lamiaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help to alleviate symptoms of various diseases such as arthritis and diabetes. The therapeutic actions of Ageratina pelotropha are attributed to its ability to relax muscles, reduce stress, and act as a natural diuretic. Research has identified bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for the plant's medicinal properties.
